Sale of Goods (Amendment) Act, 1994.

once.

Insertion of new section 16A, Act III of 1930

ACT XVIII OF 1994
ACT XVIII OF 1994
SALE OF GOODS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Sale of Goods Act, 1930
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd October, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 11th
October, 1994 and in hereby published for general information:--
2. Insertion of new section 16A, Act III of 1930.--In the Sale of
Goods Act, 1930 (III of 1930), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, after
section 16, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"16A.
Seller to inform buyer of defect in goods sold.--Notwithstanding anything
contained in section 16, and save where the parties have entered into an
agreement to the contrary, the seller shall be under an obligation to inform
the buyer of any defect in the goods sold at the time of the contract, except
in a case where the defect is obviously known to the buyer.".
